thread_tweets.text:
The biggest chance has been moving to my current system I call “trading around a core” 

Has a double meaning: keeping a core position whilst being opportunistic with trading as you already know when it’s dislocated fundamentally or oversold, and second having a core group of stocks as a base and then satellite positions for flips/mean reversion plays/special sits etc 

Prior to that I was way less active and I believe hurt my gains as meant I would have a more volatile equity curve 

Investing wise, I try to spend more time learning about management than I used to in the past 

AI: i must admit i hardly use it and i need to incorporate  it more 

How do you use AI?
